**q25.** Engine: Google CEL (`cel-go`), wrapped by the in-repo `internal/filter` package — `internal/filter/engine.go:24` (`NewEngine`, `Compile`), schema in `internal/filter/schema.go`, IR in `internal/filter/ir.go`. Mechanism: the CEL expression is compiled to a dialect-agnostic condition tree, then `internal/filter/render.go` renders it to a parameterized SQL fragment for the target `DialectName` (SQLite/Postgres/MySQL branches, e.g. `render.go:231-237, 365-411, 452-466`), and each driver appends it to its WHERE clause via `filter.AppendConditions` (`internal/filter/helpers.go:9`) — called from `store/db/sqlite/memo.go:61`, `store/db/postgres/memo.go:58`, `store/db/mysql/memo.go:69`.

Wired at `server/router/frontend/frontend.go:21-22` (embed) and `:41-60` (`Serve`), invoked from `server/server.go:69` (`frontend.NewFrontendService(profile, store).Serve(ctx, echoServer)`).

Also `server/runner/memopayload` is not a background runner despite living under `server/runner/`; it's called synchronously from `server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go:108,447`.

token kinds — short-lived JWT access token (15 min, audience "user.access-token") sent as "Authorization: Bearer …" and cached in memory/localStorage with cross-tab BroadcastChannel sync; long-lived refresh token (30 days, audience "user.refresh-token") held in the httpOnly "memos_refresh" cookie and exchanged via AuthService.RefreshToken with credentials: "include"; the same Bearer header also accepts Personal Access Tokens ("memos_pat_" prefix)
